subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should this issue be fixed as a narrow `read` fallback, upgraded into native document extraction, or deferred to broader document/file-input work?
rationale: The source-reproducible token-waste problem is real, but repository policy splits lightweight read safety, PDF tooling, plugin extraction, and provider-native document forwarding across different ownership boundaries.

options.title: Narrow safe fallback
options.body: Add a bounded PDF/Office MIME and extension guard in `read` that returns a clear unsupported/document-tool message without parsing Office archives in core.

options.title: Approve core extraction
options.body: Define the dependency, sandbox, size, ZIP/XML, and test requirements for native DOCX/PPTX/XLSX extraction before merging parser code into core.

options.title: Defer to document-input work
options.body: Keep this issue linked to the broader document attachment and provider-native file-input issues, and close or supersede stale conflicting PR attempts separately.

recommendation.title: Narrow safe fallback
recommendation.body: Add a bounded PDF/Office MIME and extension guard in `read` that returns a clear unsupported/document-tool message without parsing Office archives in core.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent Office path normalization and read-wrapper work is the best current routing signal for the product boundary choice.
